description_en: Use `ListQualityResultsByEntity` to retrieve validation results based on a partition expression
description_zh: 调用ListQualityResultsByEntity，根据分区表达式查询历史校验结果
name: ListQualityResultsByEntity

parameters.help_en: The ID of the partition expression. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174003.html operation to obtain this ID
parameters.help_zh: 分区表达式ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174003.html获取分区表达式ID
parameters.name: entity_id

parameters.help_en: The start of the business date range. The value must be in the `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss` format
parameters.help_zh: 业务日期起始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end of the business date range. The value must be in the `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss` format
parameters.help_zh: 业务日期截止时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page. The default is 10, and the maximum is 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大20条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the engine or data source. You can find this name on the Data Source Configuration page
parameters.help_zh: 引擎或者数据源的名称。您可以从数据源配置中获取名称
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace
parameters.name: project_id
